title: JAPAN — JP-04 — Foreign Nationals in Japan: Policy Justifications, Economic Exposure and Evidence Boundaries
description: Bilingual English/Japanese Project Blackbird public-record research report examining Japan's foreign-national policy, Business Manager, permanent residence, naturalisation, labour demand, enforcement, tourism, fees and JESTA. The report distinguishes documented official rationales from observed policy effects, preserves statistical population boundaries and acknowledges methodological and source-access limitations. Editorial review completed; independent peer review is not claimed.
